Capacitive Equipment Manufacturing

We manufacture various types of tanks and containers for storing liquids, bulk materials and gases.

  • Containers up to 20 m³ are manufactured entirely in-house (larger volumes available on order).
  • We design and manufacture containers in non-standard shapes and sizes, adapted to the dimensions and specifications of customer premises.

Materials used:

  • High-alloy steels: AISI-304L, AISI-308L, AISI-316L, AISI-321

  • Low-carbon steels: St.10, 20, 30

  • Aluminum and its alloys: AL, AMG, AMC

  • Titanium: WT1-00, WT-0

Typical storage environments and products:

  • Water, propylene glycol, alcohol, beer, milk and dairy products

  • Bulk materials (flour, sugar, various powders)

  • Acids, alkalis, petroleum products, gases, compressed air and others

When needed, mixers, cooling or heating jackets are mounted in containers (heat carrier can be liquid or electric current). Welding is performed by WIG-TIG, MIG-MAG methods, ensuring high reliability and hermeticity.
